title: EventBus reused source payload isolation contract

contract.reused_payload: The same source payload object can be safely reused across multiple emits
contract.listener_isolation: Mutation by one listener does not affect subsequent listeners
contract.cross_emit_isolation: Mutation during one emit does not affect subsequent emits
contract.source_integrity: The original source payload remains unchanged after delivery
contract.ordering: Listeners retain registration order across repeated emits
contract.registry_stability: Repeated emits do not mutate the listener registry
